## 1. 프로젝트 개요

### 1.1 서비스명
**CALL-ACT** \(Call + Correct + Collect + Act\)

### 1.2 서비스 슬로건
"CALL-ACT는 카드 상담사가 흩어진 약관과 정책을 한눈에 확인하고 즉시 정확한 처리를 할 수 있도록 돕는 상담 지원 서비스입니다."

### 1.3 프로젝트 목적
카드사 상담사의 업무 효율성 향상을 위한 AI 기반 실시간 문서 검색 및 상담 지원 시스템 구축

---

### 3.4 Post-Call Workflow Screen \(ACW\)

#### Page Purpose
Post-call processing screen where agents review call transcript, emotion analysis, quality feedback, and complete AI-generated consultation summary. Agents can reference similar past cases and finalize all post-call documentation.

#### User Scenario
1. Call ends, agent proceeds to ACW screen
2. Reviews call transcript in chat format
3. Checks emotion analysis graph and quality feedback \(collapsible\)
4. Reviews current case summary and similar past case reference
5. Edits AI-generated post-call document
6. Completes follow-up tasks, department handoff information
7. Saves and finalizes consultation record

#### Layout Structure

**2-Column Layout**:
- Column 1 \(Left, ~30%\): Call transcript + Feedback \(collapsible\)
- Column 2 \(Right, Main ~70%\): Similar case cards + AI-generated post-call document

### 3.5 Education Simulation Screens \(EDU\)

#### Page Purpose
Training system for new and existing employees to practice consultation scenarios using AI-generated personas. Includes scenario selection, simulated consultation \(identical to real CSU\), and post-simulation feedback.

#### User Scenario
1. Employee accesses education simulation from dashboard
2. Selects scenario category \(card loss, overseas payment, difficult customer, excellence case\)
3. AI generates persona with specific characteristics
4. Conducts simulated consultation \(identical interface to CSU\)
5. Completes post-simulation workflow \(identical to ACW\)
6. Reviews evaluation and learns from feedback
7. Can review past simulation history \(30 recent simulations\)

#### Layout Structure

**Four Sub-Screens**:
1. Scenario Selection Screen
2. Simulation In-Progress Screen \(identical to CSU\)
3. Simulation Post-Processing Screen \(identical to ACW\)
4. Simulation History List
